## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: With model.provider=openai + OpenAI default keys + OPENAI_API_KEY set, a mocked integration test produces a reviewer-findings.json that passes the same JSON schema as the Anthropic path with all 5 dimension scores populated

## Implementation Notes

Add test function `test_openai_path_produces_schema_conformant_findings` to `tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh` (append before the Summary section).

Pattern to follow: `test_runner_integration_llm_api_call_mocked` (line 2519). Key differences:
1. Set `OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-test` in the subshell env alongside (or instead of) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
2. Use the existing `_create_mock_llm_api_call` helper for `llm-api-call.sh`
3. Mock `review-complexity-classifier.sh`, `write-reviewer-findings.sh`, `record-review.sh` exactly as in the integration test
4. Assert reviewer-findings.json has all 5 numeric scores >= 0 (same Python assertion block)
5. Assert exit code 0

The runner already delegates all LLM calls to llm-api-call.sh unconditionally — no new code change required. This test verifies the delegation path works end-to-end when OPENAI_API_KEY is in the environment (simulating what a CI run with model.provider=openai would do).

## TDD Requirement

testing_mode: GREEN — unit exemption criterion 1: the runner contains no OpenAI-specific conditional logic; it delegates unconditionally to llm-api-call.sh regardless of provider. The test verifies pre-existing delegation behavior and passes immediately without any source code change. No RED phase required.

No .test-index update needed: plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh is already mapped to tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh in .test-index.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test 2>/dev/null || echo "bash tests/run-all.sh") && bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "PASSED|FAILED" | tail -1 | grep -q "FAILED: 0"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true
- [ ] test_openai_path_produces_schema_conformant_findings function exists in test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
  Verify: grep -q "test_openai_path_produces_schema_conformant_findings" tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] Test sets OPENAI_API_KEY in its subshell env
  Verify: grep -A 20 "test_openai_path_produces_schema_conformant_findings" tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh | grep -q "OPENAI_API_KEY"
- [ ] reviewer-findings.json schema assertion present (5 numeric dimensions >= 0)
  Verify: grep -A 40 "test_openai_path_produces_schema_conformant_findings" tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh | grep -q "correctness"
- [ ] Test passes (exit 0 assertion present and honored)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep "test_openai_path_produces_schema_conformant_findings.*PASS"
